dimensions.label: Motion adherence
evidence: let me just go ahead and share my screen so you can see exactly what Olly does
dimensions.tip: Start every call with open discovery questions before touching the product demo or dashboard.

dimensions.label: Discovery quality
evidence: So, tell me a little about your agency, just so I can tailor the rest of this — how many caregivers are you running right now, roughly?
dimensions.tip: Ask about goals, decision process, timeline, and pain points before pitching, not as an afterthought 25 minutes in.

dimensions.label: Talk / listen balance
dimensions.tip: Aim for more listening — open with questions and let the buyer talk.

dimensions.label: Buying-signal detection & handling
evidence: Honestly, I'm actually in talks to sell the agency in the next few months, so I'm just seeing what's out there.
dimensions.tip: When the prospect reveals a pending sale, qualify it fully (timeline, decision-maker, buyer's tech interest) instead of glossing over it to keep pitching.

dimensions.label: Objection handling
dimensions.tip: Treat vague, low-energy responses like 'I guess so' and 'Maybe, yeah' as unresolved objections and dig deeper instead of steamrolling forward.

dimensions.label: Proof-point fidelity
evidence: we typically see about a $42,000 annual savings per agency
front desk call volume dropped by almost 30% within the first two months
dimensions.tip: Only cite Sensi's published proof points (e.g., ~$500K average savings, 35% more billable hours) and never invent specific dollar figures or percentages not in the approved proof set.

dimensions.label: Next-step specificity
evidence: I can have pricing back to you by tomorrow.
dimensions.tip: Lock a specific dated meeting or call instead of an open-ended 'I'll follow up soon.'

recommendations.why: Rep led with a 25-minute unprompted demo before asking a single discovery question, violating the discovery→product→value motion.

recommendations.title: Published proof-point one-pager
recommendations.why: Rep fabricated a $42,000 savings figure and 30% call-volume drop, neither of which appear in Sensi's published proof.

recommendations.title: Qualifying exit/timeline signals playbook
recommendations.why: Prospect disclosed they are selling the agency in months, a major buying/risk signal that was not properly qualified or used to shape the pitch.

summary: This call inverted Sensi's motion entirely — a lengthy unsolicited demo with fabricated financial claims came before any discovery, and the one genuine buying signal (an impending agency sale) was brushed past rather than qualified. Objections were met with leading questions and manufactured urgency rather than genuine resolution, and the next step remains vague and undated.
